parties: Standard Greases & Specialities Pvt Ltd acquires stake in Veedol Corporation Limited
headline: Standard Greases & Specialities files SEBI Takeover disclosure for Veedol Corporation acquisition under Reg 10(6) exemption
sum: Standard Greases & Specialities Pvt Ltd has disclosed an acquisition in Veedol Corporation Limited under SEBI (SAST) Regulations 2011, Reg 10(6), relying on a prescribed exemption from the standard open offer regime.
implication: Regulation 10(6) exemptions (commonly minority acquisitions, inter-se transfers, or specified corporate restructurings) permit non-open-offer acquisitions provided disclosure is made within the prescribed timeline; transactional counsel should verify the precise exemption relied upon and document the factual basis in contemporaneous board resolutions.
detail: Standard Greases & Specialities Pvt Ltd submitted a Regulation 10(6) report to NSE on 18 August 2026 disclosing an acquisition of shares in listed entity Veedol Corporation Limited. The disclosure indicates the acquisition was made in reliance on an exemption under the SEBI Takeover Code, avoiding the mandatory open offer requirement. No acquisition value, share count or detailed terms are disclosed in the filing excerpt; the precise exemption category and factual trigger require review of the full disclosure form.
